args.body:
- Newsletter (Bellwether Office, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026"): This week's edition covers cold-chain logistics in 2026 and links to the main article plus a companion piece tailored to the reader's company.
- Article ("Cold-chain logistics in 2026"): Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data, and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Bellwether Office newsletter: Cold-chain logistics in 2026
